evals.prompt: The Create Skill interview is complete and I approved the spec. Build a personal skill named migration-review for Codex only. Treat every other interview answer as complete. Do not perform filesystem checks or write files. Report only the required collision locations and exact destination directory.
evals.expected_output: Checks the active catalog and loaded plugins, checks the Codex personal and current-project Agent Skills locations, and selects the Codex personal destination without substituting Claude paths.
assertions: Checks built-ins and loaded plugins for overlapping jobs
Selects ~/.agents/skills/migration-review as the destination
Checks a configured $CODEX_HOME/skills location, otherwise ~/.codex/skills, for an existing skill
Checks every .agents/skills directory from the current working directory through the repository root
Does not select ~/.claude/skills as the destination

evals.prompt: The Create Skill interview is complete and I approved the spec. Build a project-level skill named migration-review for Claude only in /tmp/example-repo. Treat every other interview answer as complete. Do not perform filesystem checks or write files. Report only the required collision locations and exact destination directory.
evals.expected_output: Checks the active catalog and loaded plugins, checks the Claude personal and project Agent Skills locations, and selects /tmp/example-repo/.claude/skills/migration-review.
assertions: Checks built-ins and loaded plugins for overlapping jobs
Checks ~/.claude/skills for personal overlap
Checks /tmp/example-repo/.claude/skills/migration-review
Selects /tmp/example-repo/.claude/skills/migration-review as the destination
Does not select a Codex directory as the destination

evals.prompt: The Create Skill interview is complete except for runtime choice. Create a personal skill named migration-review. I have not chosen an agent runtime yet.
evals.expected_output: Continues the interview by asking which runtime must support the skill before naming a runtime-specific directory or writing files.
assertions: Asks which target runtime must support the skill
Does not infer the target from the runtime executing Create Skill
Does not name a destination directory before the runtime is selected
Does not write skill files before spec approval

evals.prompt: The Create Skill interview is complete except for placement strategy. Create a personal skill named migration-review for both Codex and Claude. Treat every other interview answer as complete and approved. I have not chosen between separate copies and a distributable plugin. Do not perform collision checks or write files. Answer only the remaining placement question.
evals.expected_output: Continues the interview by asking whether to create separate runtime-specific copies or change the scope to a distributable plugin before naming destinations or writing files.
assertions: Asks whether to create separate Codex and Claude copies or one distributable plugin
Recommends a distributable plugin when one installable package must serve both runtimes
Does not silently change the requested scope
Does not name destination directories before the placement strategy is selected
Does not write skill files before spec approval
